psychological_meaning: Sepia evokes feelings of nostalgia, antiquity, and history. It is often associated with vintage photographs and a sense of timelessness. The color can also suggest stability, reliability, and a connection to the past.

real_world_examples.title: Antique Photographs
real_world_examples.description: Old photographs often develop a sepia tone over time, contributing to their nostalgic appeal.

real_world_examples.title: Leather Furniture
real_world_examples.description: Sepia-toned leather furniture adds a touch of classic elegance to any room.

how_to_pair: Pair with creams and off-whites for a classic look.
Combine with greens and blues for an earthy feel.
Use as an accent color against a neutral background.
